Name: Frieren's and Fern's Staff
Author: walkingdeesaster
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/wJhPRJH/frieren-s-fern-s-staff.png[/img]
I loved the anime Frieren so  much, I wanted to see a lil bit of it back in my game.
This mod replaces *only* the vanilla scarecrow & deluxe scarecrows to their staffs.
Fern's staff replaces the scarecrow & Frieren's staff replaces the deluxe scarecrow.
Works with recent 1.6 update

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JaKDlXc.png[/img]﻿
All artwork done by me ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/79651573]walkingdeesaster[/url] ﻿/ IG [url=https://www.instagram.com/deedraws/]@deedraws[/url]﻿). Staff design by Frieren: Beyond Journey's End

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/lggWdEY.png[/img]
Download this mod
Unzip in Mods folder
Craft scarecrow as is
Have fun![/center]
